doctrine: HUMANS GOVERN THE SYSTEM. THE SYSTEM GOVERNS THE PRODUCTS. A product satisfying every mandatory rule of this approved Publication Constitution is autonomously authorized for publication without per-product owner approval.

rules.text: Every gate g0-g9 must be in its required state.
An ACTIVE applicable Domain Authority Pack must govern the product.
The TSM must be classified by the TSM Constitution (not a fabricated efficacy claim).
No unresolved blocker (FAIL quality failure, missing authoritative input) may remain.
The design authority must be satisfied (design-inheritance compliance).
The manifest builders must be able to derive a schema-valid manifest from the gate ledger.
Authorization is recorded with authority lineage (constitution versions + evaluation), never a fabricated per-product authorizer name beyond the system constitution.

automatic_authorization_conditions: g4, g5, g9 AUTHORIZED by the applicable constitutions + Domain Authority Pack
automatic_rejection_conditions: any required gate not in its required state

authorization_semantics.record: product.publishing.authorization { status: READY_TO_PUBLISH, authorization_basis: AUTHORIZED_BY_PUBLICATION_CONSTITUTION, publication_constitution: <id@version>, authority_lineage, evaluated_at, evaluator }

provenance.note: The owner governs THIS constitution at system level; products are governed by it. This removes the per-product owner click while preserving owner authority over the rules.
